summary: Move from one global cap to a portfolio of outcome-aware, staged allowances.

items.text: Allocate separate exploration, implementation and verification envelopes, with a protected reserve for tests and handoff.
Permit budget increases only through a machine-readable request containing progress evidence, remaining risk and an estimated next checkpoint.
Continuously compare provider, model and strategy by cost per accepted task and escaped-defect rate, then tune defaults by task class.
